description: This file defines the TickLabels class, which manages the formatting and properties of tick labels on chart axes within the MigraDoc document object model. It includes properties for style, format, and font, along with serialization and deep copy functionalities.

classes.name: TickLabels
classes.description: Represents the format of axis tick labels within a chart, supporting style, format, font, serialization, and copying.

classes.name: TickLabelsValues
classes.description: Holds the internal nullable values for the TickLabels properties such as Style, Format, and Font.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the TickLabels object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Implements deep copying logic for the TickLabels object, including cloning the Font if it exists.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the TickLabels object into DDL format.
